results.description: An object mapping event type identifiers (as strings) to event objects. Each key in this object is the unique event type (matching the `type` field in the event object, e.g., "een.deviceCloudStatusUpdateEvent.v1"), and the corresponding value is the event data for that type. If no events are found for a particular type, that type will not appear as a key in the object. If no events are found at all, the object will be empty. The key format is the same as the `type` field in the event object.

AccessActivationEvent.description: Generated when an access activation is made at an access control point (door, gate, reader, etc.). This event uses a device-centric approach where the access control point is the actor. The event includes separate data schemas for user access decision and credential information, allowing independent tracking of user activity and credential usage.

AccountCreationEvent.description: Generated when an account is created.

AccountDeletionEvent.description: Generated when an account is deleted.

AccountUpdateEvent.description: Generated when an account is updated.

AllPublicEventsReadOnly.description: List of all public events with read-only access.

AnimalDetectionEvent.description: Generated when there is an animal in motion in front of the camera. The event represents the span of time for which the animal was in motion, and a null `endTimestamp` indicates that the animal's motion was still ongoing when the event was  retrieved.

AreaV1.description: List of 3 or more coordinates representing the area. The first and last coordinate should be connected by the client  to complete the area. For each two-value coordinate, the first value represents the horizontal position (from left) as a percentage of the  image width, and the second value represents the vertical position (from top) as a percentage of the total image height.

type.description: Specific data schema type, eg `een.lprDetection.v1` which describes what other fields will exist in this object.

creatorId.description: Id of the application or system that created this piece of information, generally the same as the `creatorId` of the event itself. This field allows clients to disambiguate data from multiple sources in the same event.

BatteryLevelUpdateEvent.description: Generated when there is an update in the level of a device's battery.

BoundingBoxV1.description:
Array of 4 floats describing a bounding box around the object of interest. Note that the percentage defined below
is as a decimal value between 0 and 1. This means 55% would have to be provided as 0.55.
* First - top left corner horizontal position (from left) as a percentage of the image width.
* Second - top left corner vertical position (from top) as a percentage of the total image height.
* Third - bottom right corner horizontal position (from left) as a percentage of the image width.
* Fourth - bottom right corner vertical position (from top) as a percentage of the image height.

ColorDefinitions.description: Standard color enumerations used across all object classes (person, vehicle, etc.).

CrowdFormationDetectionEvent.description: Detects the formation of a crowd of people.

DataPurgedEvent.description: Generated for each portion of recorded data that is deleted during a purge operation. The event's `startTimestamp` and `endTimestamp` represent the time range of the recorded data that was deleted. Contains details about how many bytes were freed.

DeviceCloudConnectionStatus.description:
Indicates the connection status of the device. The statuses defined here should be in sync with the DeviceStatus schema.
  * `online`: The device is online and operational.
  * `deviceOffline`: The device is offline.
  * `bridgeOffline`: The bridge that connects to the device itself has no connection with the cloud. 
  * `off`: The device is online, but has been turned off by the user.
  * `error`: The device is offline due to some problem that has not been described by any of the other statuses.
  * `unknown`: The device state is unknown for some reason.
  * `invalidCredentials`: Credentials for this device are not valid.

DeviceCloudConnectionStatusUpdateEvent.description: Generated when a device's connection status to the cloud changes. The event represents the span of time the device stays in the given state, and a null `endTimestamp` indicates it was still in the given state when the event was retrieved.

DeviceCloudStatusUpdateEvent.description: Generated when a device's status changes. The event represents the span of time the device stays in the given state, and a null `endTimestamp` indicates it was still in the given state when the event was retrieved.

DeviceCommonStatus.description:
Indicates the operational status of the device. The statuses defined here should be in sync with the DeviceStatus schema.
  * `operational`: The device is online and operational.
  * `error`: Device not working (requires error details).
  * `disabled`: Operational but intentionally not recording telemetry
  * `unreachable`: The device is not reachable (e.g., offline, out of service).
  * `unknown`: The device state is unknown for some reason.
  * `initializing`: The device is in the process of initializing.

DeviceCreationEvent.description: Generated when a device is added.

DeviceDeletionEvent.description: Generated when a device is deleted.

DeviceErrorStatus.description:
Indicates the detailed error status of a device, grouped by device type:
ONVIF Camera / RTSP Camera / Multicamera:
  * `generalDeviceError`: Camera error
  * `networkError`: Network error
  * `invalidCredentials`: Invalid credentials
  * `deviceSupportIssue`: Device support issue
  * `queuedForConfiguration`: Queued for configuration
  * `configurationInProgress`: Configuration in progress
  * `deviceDisabled`: Device is turned off
  * `disconnectedFromBridge`: Disconnected from bridge

Analog Camera:
  * `analogNoPower`: Power loss detected
  * `analogBadSignal`: Signal quality issue
  * `analogIncompatibleSignal`: Incompatible signal
  * `analogNoSignal`: No signal
  * `disconnectedFromBridge`: Disconnected from bridge
  * `deviceDisabled`: Device is turned off

Managed Switch:
  * `deviceSupportIssue`: Switch support issue
  * `disconnectedFromBridge`: Disconnected from bridge

DeviceUpdateEvent.description: Generated when a device is updated.

EdgeReportedDeviceStatusEvent.description: Generated when a device's status changes. The event represents the span of time the device stays in the given state, and a null `endTimestamp` indicates it was still in the given state when the event was retrieved.

idleCircuitState.description:
Indicates the normal, inactive or idle, state of the connected circuit.
Possible values:

* `open`: means the port is "off" when in `idle` state (open circuit; has no voltage), and the port state being `active` means it is turned "on" (circuit is closed; has voltage).
* `closed`: means the port is "on" when in `idle` state (closed circuit; has voltage), and the port state being active means it is turned "off" (open circuit; has no voltage).

EenT3AlarmAudioDetectionEvent.description: Generated upon detecting the sound of a T3 alarm, which is defined as "Audible Emergency Evacuation Signal" by the ANSI S3.41 and ISO 8201 standards. This alarm is normally used to indicate the presence of smoke or fire, but can be used in any situation that requires immediate evacuation of the building.

EenT4AlarmAudioDetectionEvent.description: Generated upon detecting the sound of a T4 alarm, which is specifically designed to indicate high levels of carbon monoxide (CO).

allOf.description: References the bounding box of where the temperature change was recorded.

It represents the area configured to be monitored for thermal events, with additional configurations defined for the area. If multiple regions are configured for the same type, we only add the area in which the event was detected.

detectionType.description:
Type of detection configured for the area based on temperature changes.
  * `above`: The alarm will trigger if the value goes above the threshold value.
  * `below`: The alarm will trigger if the value goes below the threshold value.
  * `increase`: The alarm will trigger if the temperature increases faster than the threshold value divided by the delay time.
  * `decrease`: The alarm will trigger if the temperature decreases faster than the threshold value divided by the delay time.

threshold.description: The temperature threshold for the area that should trigger the alarm.

delay.description: Delay time in seconds, the temperature has to be over the threshold before the alarm triggers, configured for the area.

userId.description: The unique identifier of the user attempting access. This is typically an ID from the access control system (e.g., Brivo user ID).

allOf.description:
Object containing all user information associated with the specific event. For example, for a plate read, this would contain user supplied attributes for the given plate like apartment number. the following are the guidelines for supplying User Data:
  * Fields Should be in camelCase
  * Maximum of 5 unique keys.
  * Each key or value should have only 256 characters max.
Tags containing all user information associated with the specific vehicle entry.

tag.description: Tag provided by user for a vehicle entry

allOf.description: Attributes of the vehicle that created the LPR event.

timestamp.description: Optional timestamp of the frame at which these attributes were inferred.

allOf.description: Enumerations of standard colors for vehicles.

colorConfidence.description: Confidence of the color classification reported as a float value between 0 and 1.

colorRgb.description: Optional RGB color values for the vehicle color. Preserves precise color data.

allOf.description: Make of the vehicle

makeDisplay.description: UI ready display name of the make of the vehicle

makeConfidence.description: The confidence of the make classification reported as a float value between 0 and 1.

modelConfidence.description: The confidence of the model classification reported as a float value between 0 and 1.

allOf.description: Type of the vehicle

bodyTypeDisplay.description: UI ready display name of the bodyType of the vehicle

bodyTypeConfidence.description: The confidence of the body type classification reported as a float value between 0 and 1.

yearConfidence.description: The confidence of the year classification reported as a float value between 0 and 1.

orientation.description: Orientation of vehicle w.r.t. the camera. In other words, it describes how the camera viewed a specific vehicle.

parked.description: Information regarding whether the vehicle is parked or not

parkedConfidence.description: The confidence on the value of `parked` key reported as a float value between 0 and 1.

allOf.description: Provides details of vehicle lists that include a license plate for which an LPR event was triggered. This is a system-generated data schema and cannot be created using POST API calls.

vehicleListId.description: The unique uuid of the vehicle list

vehicleListName.description: The user defined name of the vehicle list

allOf.description: Object containing the insights details generated by the VSP package for a License Plate Recognition (LPR) event. These insights provide information such as first-time appearances, hotlist matches, or count of occurrences.

insightType.description:
A short identifier representing the type of insight. Example values include:
  - `visitorType`: Classification of visitor - "new" for first visit within the retention period, "frequent" for vehicle occurring weekly within the retention period
  - `visitCount`: Count of total visits (entry & exit pairs) in the last 7 days
  - `avgDurationSec`: Average duration of visits in seconds based on visits in the last 7 days
  - `new`: First appearance of the plate (legacy)
  - `count`: Indicates number of times the vehicle has been seen (legacy)
  - `hotlist`: hotlisted vehicle (legacy)

label.description: User-friendly label for displaying the insight type. Examples: "Visitor Type", "Total Visits", "Average Duration"

value.description: Optional value associated with the insightType.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of the insight, intended for end users. A single tag can have multiple different descriptions, depending on the context or additional data associated with the insight.

allOf.description: Attributes related to a weapon object detected in an event image

type.description: Type of this data schema. The value is fixed as 'een.weaponAttributes.v1'

allOf.description: Class of the weapon.

EvacuateProtocolEvent.description: Generated when an evacuation is initiated, indicating that people need to move from one location to another, either within or outside the building. May include information about the affected location.

EventEnvelopeParent.description: Parent for envelope for een events

id.description: System wide unique id of the event

startTimestamp.description: Time at which the event starts.

endTimestamp.description: Time at which the event ended. If null, the event is ongoing.

span.description: True if the event describes a period of time instead of a single moment in time.

accountId.description: Id of the account the event belongs in. This can be a different account than the account of the actor that changed as part of the event, see the `actorAccountId` description for more details.

actorId.description: Id of the entity that changed as part of the event, such as a camera id, user id, or account id. This id represents the specific entity that underwent a change, triggering the event notification.

actorAccountId.description: Id of the account to which the changed actor belongs. This might be different from the `accountId` field in cases where one account is helping to manage another one. For example, a reseller that manages the bridges for one of their end-users would want to get alerts in their own account (`accountId`) that are about bridges located in their end-user's account (actorAccountId).

actorType.description: Type of actor that changed, triggering the event.

creatorId.description: Id of the application or system that created this event. This id should not differ between instances or even versions of the same application.

type.description: Specific event type, e.g. een.motionDetectionEvent.v1, een.lprPlateReadEvent.v1

dataSchemas.description: List of all data schema types that can be found in this event.

data.description: Event specific data given as an array of objects that have a `type` field indicates the schema of the value.

FaceDetectionEvent.description: Generated when a face is detected in the camera's view.

FallDetectionEvent.description: Generated when a fall is detected, potentially indicating an accident or medical emergency.

FightDetectionEvent.description: Generated when a fight is detected in the field of view for longer than a given duration.

FireDetectionEvent.description: Generated when a fire is detected.

FleetCodeRecognitionEvent.description: Generated when the camera captures a fleet code of a passing vehicle. It represents a single point in time.

GunDetectionEvent.description: Generated when a weapon is detected in the camera's view..

HandsUpDetectionEvent.description: Generated when a person with their hands up is detected.

HoldProtocolEvent.description: Generated when a hold protocol is initiated, instructing individuals to follow the directive: "In Your Room or Area" to keep hallways clear of occupants.

JobCreationEvent.description: Generated when a job is created.

JobDeletionEvent.description: Generated when a job is deleted.

JobUpdateEvent.description: Generated when a job is updated.

LayoutCreationEvent.description: Generated when a layout is created.

LayoutDeletionEvent.description: Generated when a layout is deleted.

LayoutUpdateEvent.description: Generated when a layout is updated.

LineV1.description: List of 2 coordinates representing the line. For each two-value coordinate, the first value represents the horizontal position (from left) as a percentage of the  image width, and the second value represents the vertical position (from top) as a percentage of the total image height.

LockdownProtocolEvent.description: Generated when a lockdown protocol is initiated, instructing individuals to follow "Locks, Lights, Out of Sight" to secure rooms and remain quiet and in place.

LoiterDetectionEvent.description: Generated when an object remains in a specific area for an extended period of time, potentially indicating suspicious activity or unauthorized lingering.

LprPlateReadEvent.description: Generated when the camera captures a license plate of a passing vehicle. It can either be a span event or a point event. When the event is a span event, it represents the time period during which the vehicle was detected, here event will have different start and end time. When the event is a point event, it is the time of plate read trigger and both start and end times would be same.

MeasurementDisplayUnitType.description: The unit of measurement that the measurement reports in.

MeasurementPropertyType.description: The property that the measurement is measuring.

MeasurementThresholdStatusEvent.description: Generated when there is a change in status related to a measurement's threshold.

MotionDetectionEvent.description: Generated when there is a motion in front of the camera. The event represents the span of time for which the motion happened, and a null `endTimestamp` indicates that the motion was still ongoing when the event was  retrieved.

MotionInRegionDetectionEvent.description: Generated when there is a motion in a configured region of interest. The event represents the span of time for which the motion happened, and a null `endTimestamp` indicates that the motion was still ongoing when the event was  retrieved.

ObjectIdV1.description:
ID given to the object by the detector. It is namespaced with a prefix to guarantee uniqueness while not
needing different detectors like camera, edge based algorithms and cloud based algorithms to coordinate.
The the prefix is followed by a colon and then the unique (within the namespace) id of the object.

ObjectIntrusionEvent.description: Generated when an unauthorized object enters a restricted or monitored area, potentially indicating a security breach or intrusion attempt.

ObjectLineCrossCountEvent.description: Generated when counting analytics is enabled and an object crosses a predefined virtual line or boundary within a monitored area. This event is distinct from object line cross events and is used specifically for statistical counting purposes rather than alerting.

ObjectLineCrossEvent.description: Generated when an object crosses a predefined virtual line or boundary within a monitored area.

ObjectRemovalEvent.description: Generated when an object is removed from a designated or monitored area, potentially signaling a security concern, such as theft or loss. The schema for object detection is related to the removed object. The timestamp and image provided correspond to the moment when the object's removal was detected. The object detection bounding box points at the location the object previously was.

PPEViolationEvent.description: Generated when PPE  Violation (Personal Protective Equipment Violation) is detected in the camera's view.

PaginatedMappedResponseWithSize.description: Used to wrap results for a paginated response with map-based results, containing information on how to retrieve further pages and the total number of results. Results are returned as a map/object instead of an array.

nextPageToken.description: Token to retrieve the next page. The value of this token is passed into the field pageToken. This value can be null if there is no next page.

prevPageToken.description: Token to retrieve the previous page. The value of this token is passed into the field pageToken. This value can be null of there is no previous page.

totalSize.description: Size of the total result set.

results.description: The result set from a collection API call, returned as a map.

PanicButtonEvent.description: Generated when a user triggers a panic button, indicating an urgent safety concern or distress situation.

PersonDetectionEvent.description: Generated when there is a person in motion in front of the camera. The event represents the span of time for which the person was in motion, and a null `endTimestamp` indicates that the person's motion was still ongoing when the event was  retrieved.

allOf.description: Enumerations of lowerbody clothing color for person.

PersonMotionDetectionEvent.description: Generated when there is a person in motion in front of the camera. The event represents the span of time for which the person was in motion, and a null `endTimestamp` indicates that the person's motion was still ongoing when the event was  retrieved.

PersonTailgateEvent.description: Generated when an unauthorized person follows an authorized individual through a secure access point, potentially indicating a security breach.

allOf.description: Enumerations of upperbody clothing color for person.

PoSTransactionEvent.description: Generated when a transaction is performed on Point of Sale (PoS) terminal integrated with Eagle Eye VMS. It is a span event and has a separate start and end time.

PosPaymentMethod.description:
The payment method used for the transaction:
- cash: Physical currency in the form of bills and coins
- creditCard: Credit card payment
- debitCard: Debit card payment
- unknownCard: Card type could not be determined
- bankAccount: Direct bank transfer or account payment
- check: Paper check payment
- giftCard: Payment using store or merchant gift card
- crypto: Payment using cryptocurrency
- storeCredit: Payment using store credit balance
- buyNowPayLater: Deferred payment services (e.g., Affirm, Klarna)
- wallet: Digital wallet payment (e.g., Apple Pay, Google Pay)
- amex: American Express card payment
- discover: Discover card payment
- masterCard: Mastercard payment
- visa: Visa card payment
- ebt: Electronic Benefit Transfer card for government assistance programs
- keyFob: Payment using RFID key fob
- storedValueCard: Payment using pre-loaded value card
- other: Other payment methods not listed
- none: No payment method specified

PosTransactionLabel.description: Indicates the labels that is assigned to a POS transaction. The list of valid labels may be expanded in future. Clients should handle new values gracefully. The `refund` label is deprecated and will be removed in a future version.

PosTransactionType.description: Indicates the type of transaction. Either purchase, refund, void or noSale. The values may change in future as new transaction types are supported.

PtzPositionUpdateEvent.description: Generated when there is a change in the ptz position of a camera.

PurgeEvent.description: Generated when a purge operation is initiated due to insufficient disk space.

SceneLabelEvent.description: Generated whenever an image is labeled with object metadata. It merely represents the state of the scene at that point in time. This event is sufficient to describe the information related to 0 or more objects present in the scene at that point in time. Consequently, there can be more than one occurrence of each schema in this event data. For example, if there are two persons in the scene, there will be two instances of each of objectDetection, objectClassification, personAttributes schema. The consumer of this data is expected to use the objectId which is present in each dataSchema to link information for each instance of the object in the scene, as objectId will be unique per object in the scene.

SecureProtocolEvent.description: Generated when a secure protocol is initiated, instructing individuals to follow the directive: "Get Inside. Lock Outside Doors" to safeguard people within the building.

ShelterProtocolEvent.description: Generated when a shelter directive is issued for group or individual protection.

SpillDetectionEvent.description: Detects a liquid that has been spilled and may represent a slipping hazard.

TamperDetectionEvent.description: Generated when someone is trying to block the camera's view or the image is greatly altered.

ThermalCameraThresholdStatusEvent.description: Generated when a thermal camera detects temperature changes based on user-defined thresholds, in a monitored area. It captures metadata including temperature values, coordinates, and status changes.

UserCreationEvent.description: Generated when a user is created.

UserDeletionEvent.description: Generated when a user is deleted.

UserUpdateEvent.description: Generated when a user is updated.

VapeDetectionEvent.description: Generated when vaping activity is detected by a sensor.

VehicleBodyTypeDefinitions.description: Enumerations of standard classes for vehicles. Warning: These body types are subject to future modifications

allOf.description: Enumerations of standard colors for vehicles.

VehicleDetectionEvent.description: Generated when there is a vehicle in motion in front of the camera. The event represents the span of time for which the vehicle was in motion, and a null `endTimestamp` indicates that the vehicle's motion was still ongoing when the event was  retrieved.

VehicleMakeDefinitions.description: Enumerations of standard makes/brands for vehicles.

VehicleMotionDetectionEvent.description: Generated when there is a vehicle in motion in front of the camera. The event represents the span of time for which the vehicle was in motion, and a null `endTimestamp` indicates that the vehicle's motion was still ongoing when the event was  retrieved.

ViolenceDetectionEvent.description: Generated when violent behavior or physical aggression is detected in the camera's field of view.

VisitorRegistrationEvent.description: Generated when a visitor to a site or building is registered.

WeaponDetectionEvent.description: Generated when a weapon is detected in the camera's view..

deviceCloudConnectionStatusV2.description:
Socket connection state between device and cloud
  * `connected`: The device socket connected to cloud.
  * `disconnected`: The device socket disconnected from cloud.
